sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate defines the required scoped strengthening envelopes, extents, endpoints, reference points, or cross-owner paths; the available booleans and quantities cannot encode those spatial relationships.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The conditional status equalities do not encode the mandatory strengthening envelopes: the IA Super forefoot branch never checks the five-main-frame-spacing extent, and the high-speed IA Super/IA branch never checks the 2 m vertical extent or the longitudinal extent of at least 0.2 L abaft the forward perpendicular. The optional, unconnected spacing/thickness quantity shapes are not substitutes for these scoped relationships and allow the shape to pass without any envelope evidence. Locate canonical terms/paths for the relevant strengthening extents, ship length/forward-perpendicular reference, or canonical scope-specific status concepts, then constrain them in the applicable branches without encoding the advisory lower-speed sentence as mandatory.

The candidate still omits both mandatory strengthening branches identified previously. Add the IA Super forefoot condition using iceClass and require forefootShellStrengtheningStatus to be bow-region-equivalent over the extent from the stem to five main-frame spacings abaft the bow-profile/keel-line departure point. Add the IA Super/IA condition using openWaterServiceSpeed with an inclusive 18 kn threshold and require upperBowIceBeltStrengtheningStatus to be midbody-equivalent over both the 2 m vertical extent and the longitudinal extent from the stem to at least 0.2 × shipLength abaft the forward perpendicular. Use the now-supplied canonical shipLength QUDT quantity in metres. Locate canonical terms or paths for the still-missing scoped extents and reference points rather than treating unscoped boolean statuses as envelope evidence. Also include every COMPLETE-contract directConstraintTerm omitted by this graph, including iceClass, openWaterServiceSpeed, designOperationSpeedInIce, spacing, thickness, bowRegionEquivalent, midbodyEquivalent, forefootShellStrengtheningStatus, and upperBowIceBeltStrengtheningStatus, with their canonical owners, datatypes, and units. Preserve the sidescuttle prohibition and weather-deck conditional, and do not make the advisory lower-speed/model-test sentence mandatory.

Preserve the prior instructions: the candidate still encodes only unscoped status booleans and quantity presence, not the mandatory strengthening envelopes. In the IA Super forefoot branch, relate forefootShellStrengtheningStatus/bowRegionEquivalent to the shell area from the stem through five main-frame spacings abaft the bow-profile/keel-line departure point; the global spacing value does not establish that extent. In the IA Super/IA branch at openWaterServiceSpeed >= 18 kn, relate upperBowIceBeltStrengtheningStatus/midbodyEquivalent to both the vertical area from the ice-belt upper limit to exactly 2 m above it and the longitudinal area from the stem to at least 0.2 × shipLength abaft the forward perpendicular; mere shipLength presence does not perform or evidence this comparison. Locate canonical scope, extent, endpoint, and reference-point terms or cross-owner paths absent from the supplied vocabulary, and keep them on their authoritative owners. Preserve the sidescuttle prohibition, weather-deck conditional, inclusive 18 kn threshold, supplied directConstraintTerms, datatypes/units, and omission of the advisory lower-speed model-test sentence.
